rules.headings: tracking-tight or tracking-tighter, uppercase for panel titles. Use font-light to font-black for weight contrast.
rules.numbers: Use Chivo for large data points and metrics, tight line height (leading-none).
rules.terminal: Use JetBrains Mono for the Brain Panel to give a retro-futurist institutional feel.
rules.labels: Uppercase, tiny text (text-xs), wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines and labels.

visual_enhancers.texture: Use a subtle CSS noise/grain overlay (opacity 0.02) over the entire dashboard to kill digital flatness and enhance the 'institutional' feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). Make the grid skeleton visible with border-collapse styles where applicable.
visual_enhancers.glows: Use subtle drop-shadows (e.g., drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(34,211,238,0.5)]) ONLY for the 'Active' AI agent in the Brain Panel or high-conviction signals.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid heavy glass in this dashboard to maintain high-contrast data clarity. Use flat, solid surfaces with 1px borders.

layouts.container: w-full min-h-screen bg-[#0A0A0B] text-[#F4F4F5] p-2 md:p-4 font-body overflow-x-hidden
layouts.spacing: Tight gaps between major panels (gap-4). Internal padding for cards should be generous enough for readability (p-4 to p-6).

structure.header: Top bar: Logo left, Stock Search center, Global Status right. border-b border-[#27272A].
structure.main_grid: CSS Grid: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 mt-4.
structure.signals_row: col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Shows Buy/Sell, Win Prob, Sentiment Score, Risk/Reward.
structure.chart_area: col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 h-[500px] border border-[#27272A] bg-[#121214].
structure.brain_panel: col-span-12 lg:col-span-4 lg:row-span-2 border border-[#27272A] bg-[#050505] flex flex-col.
structure.bottom_row: col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 (News Feed & Backtesting Results).

components.name: Header & Search
components.rules: Solid background. Input uses Shadcn but heavily customized: flat, no rounded corners, border-[#27272A], focus:border-[#0EA5E9] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0EA5E9]. Left align text.

components.name: Data Cards (Bento Items)
components.rules: Flat background (#121214), 1px solid border (#27272A). No shadow by default. On hover: slight border color lighten, NO translateY lift to keep institutional feel solid. Metric values in Chivo, tracking-tight.

components.name: Brain Panel (Agent Terminal)
components.rules: Retro-Futurism style. Black background (#050505). Divide into 4 sections for agents. Active agent gets a cyan left-border and text glow. Use JetBrains Mono for streaming thought processes. Add a blinking cursor block.

components.name: Candlestick Chart
components.rules: Integrate 'lightweight-charts'. Customize colors: background #121214, grid lines #27272A, up color #10B981, down color #EF4444. Overlay custom HTML labels for AI Signals (Buy/Sell markers).

components.name: News Feed
components.rules: List layout. Each item has a sentiment badge (Green/Red/Grey). Hover state highlights the row with a very subtle background (#18181B).

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Button hovers change background to a lighter hue of active state.
motion.agent_thinking: Use framer-motion to create a pulsing opacity effect (0.5 to 1) for the 'thinking' status of agents.
motion.data_updates: When a signal probability changes, animate the number counter or flash the background briefly (green/red) at 10% opacity.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use #F4F4F5 for primary text, #A1A1AA for secondary.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus rings on search and interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='stock-search-input', data-testid='buy-signal-card').

3d_libraries.decision: Not using heavy 3D for this institutional dashboard to maintain maximum performance and data clarity. Relying on lightweight-charts for primary visualization.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind config with the specified colors, fonts (Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono), and sharp border radii.
2. Install 'lightweight-charts' for the candlestick chart. Do not use generic recharts for the main price chart.
3. Install 'lucide-react' for icons, 'framer-motion' for agent thinking animations, and 'sonner' for toasts.
4. Build the layout using CSS Grid based on the high-density 'Bento' grid protocol. Ensure all grid items stretch to fill.
5. For the 'Brain Panel', implement a scrolling terminal-like view using JetBrains Mono. Mock the 4 agents' thought streams (Technical, Sentiment, Risk, Chief).
6. Add a subtle noise overlay fixed to the background to break digital flatness.
7. Mock the chart data (candlesticks) and the agent logs since there's no real backend provided yet.
8. Implement Shadcn UI for inputs/badges but override them to remove rounded corners (use rounded-none or rounded-sm) and apply the technical border styles.
9. DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or the header.
10. Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...). Pages MUST use default exports.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
